item.title: Gemini 2.0: Advancing Multimodal Reasoning and Autonomous Agent Capabilities
item.author: DeepMind Team
item.description: We introduce Gemini 2.0, our next-generation multimodal model engineered for complex agentic workflows and real-time audio and vision processing. We develop native tool use and code execution mechanisms that let agents act in external environments safely. Evaluation across competitive benchmarks reveals state-of-the-art reasoning and substantial efficiency improvements.
